name: @tribunus/protocol — Protocol Spine Package
description: Extract the canonical protocol package containing all schemas, enums, and contracts: event envelopes, receipt schemas, lifecycle enums, capability descriptors, work state transitions, federation object types, and compatibility codecs. This is the PREREQUISITE for SDK and plugin work.
purpose: All Tribunus components — app runtime, SDK, plugins, mobile PWA, federation — speak the same language through one shared protocol package.
acceptanceCriteria: Event envelope schemas for federation, plugin, and lifecycle events
Receipt schemas for governance, capability, dharma, and audit
Lifecycle enums for project state, session state, work item state, gate state
Capability descriptors with permission classes, scope definitions, risk levels
Work state transition validators for all entity state machines
Federation object types with envelope formats and signing schemes
Compatibility codecs for versioning, migration paths, deprecation policies
